comment: Single source of truth for the bundled native VapourSynth plugins of qtgmc-6ui. Read by build.sh (via manifest.py) and by the PKGBUILD generator (source=/sha256sums=/depends=/makedepends=). Each source is fetched as 'filename::url' and verified by sha256; build.sh only reads the files from <srcdir> and never touches the network.

components.name: akarin
components.build_system: meson (LLVM JIT backend, -Dstatic-llvm=false, llvm-config of llvm22)
components.notes: Needed by vsjetpack norm_expr (akarin.Expr). meson.build pins llvm >=20,<23; Arch's default llvm is 23, so the build uses extra/llvm22 through a meson native file (llvm-config=/usr/lib/llvm22/bin/llvm-config). llvm22 has no full static libs, hence -Dstatic-llvm=false and a runtime dependency on llvm22-libs (libLLVM.so.22.1, ~150 MB). Considered alternative: -Dasmjit=true drops LLVM entirely but compiles every C++ file with -mavx (SIGILL on pre-AVX CPUs, violates the generic x86-64 baseline) and only implements the legacy 'expr' path, not the expr2 features vsjetpack uses; rejected. If Arch drops llvm22, bump akarin to a release that accepts the then-current llvm.

components.name: resize2
components.build_system: meson with a private, patched zimg subproject (what the zimg.wrap would fetch)
components.notes: Needed by vskernels (Catrom bob of the draft clip). Links a PATCHED zimg statically (-Wl,-Bsymbolic-functions), so Arch's zimg cannot replace it and it is not a runtime dependency.

components.name: mvutensils
components.build_system: meson, only the baseline target 'mvutensils.so' is built (the .avx2/.zn4 whole-library variants and manifest.vs are skipped)
components.notes: PINNED TO v9: v10 removed the fields/tff arguments and vsjetpack 2.2.6 fails with 'AnalyseMany: Function does not take argument(s) named fields'. Bump together with vsjetpack (main has MVUtensils v10 support). The baseline library still runtime-dispatches its AVX2/AVX-512 kernels; with QTGMC6UI_MARCH=x86-64-v3/native the whole library additionally follows -march. Uses Arch's zimg (libzimg.so.2) and fftw (libfftw3f.so.3) at runtime.

components.name: znedi3
components.build_system: upstream GNU Makefile: make X86=1 X86_AVX512=1 vsznedi3.so (SIMD kernels runtime-dispatched)
components.notes: Default QTGMC bobber (vsaa.NNEDI3 -> znedi3.nnedi3). The plugin reads nnedi3_weights.bin from the directory of vsznedi3.so, so both are installed side by side. GitHub tag archives have empty submodule dirs, hence the two extra pinned tarballs.

components.name: zsmooth
components.build_system: zig build with the pinned Zig 0.16.0 release toolchain (not Arch's zig), offline: every dependency tarball is placed in a private zig global cache with 'zig fetch' and checked against the hash in build.zig.zon

sources.role: zig dependency 'fftw' (zig build wrapper, tag v3.3.11-2)
transitive zig dependency: FFTW sources, compiled statically into libzsmooth.so
build toolchain only, not shipped: official static Zig 0.16.0 release (sha256 from ziglang.org/download/index.json)

components.notes: Needed for LosslessMode.POSTSMOOTH (anti-comb repair/remove_grain) and median_blur. Built with a pinned Zig 0.16.0 toolchain tarball, not Arch's zig: Zig 0.17 (Arch extra/zig since 2026-10-20) removed @cImport, the ReleaseFast optimize-mode names and the --global-cache-dir option of zig fetch, so zsmooth 0.20.0 and its zig dependencies do not compile with it, and Arch has no versioned zig package. Target x86_64-linux-gnu, -Dcpu=x86_64 by default (x86_64_v3 / native with QTGMC6UI_MARCH); zig does not use CFLAGS. FFTW (GPL-2.0-or-later) is linked statically, so the shipped binary is GPL-2.0-or-later as a whole.

components.name: dfttest2
components.build_system: cmake (CMakeLists.txt of the vs-wheels PyPI sdist; the git tag has no build system and an empty vectorclass submodule); sse2/avx2/avx512f kernels runtime-dispatched

python_wheels.role: python module 'dfttest2' imported by vsdenoise.DFTTest; NOT built by build.sh, the venv step installs it (--no-deps)

components.notes: Optional: only for the optional denoise (DENOISE_UNAVAILABLE without it). Upstream wheels build with clang++ -ffast-math; we use the system C++ compiler with makepkg CXXFLAGS plus -ffast-math (as upstream).

components.name: vivtc
components.notes: Extra, not shipped by default: telecine detection uses FFmpeg idet/fieldmatch (architecture 1.8) and QTGMC does not use VFM/VDecimate. Recipe kept so it can be enabled cheaply.

components.name: vszip
components.build_system: zig build with the pinned Zig 0.16.0 toolchain, offline like zsmooth

sources.role: build toolchain only, not shipped: official static Zig 0.16.0 release (sha256 from ziglang.org/download/index.json)

components.notes: Extra, not shipped by default: declared dependency of vsjetpack but verified unused by QTGMC with our settings. Recipe kept for later features.
